params.title: Payment batch
params.note: payroll-sepa-netpay-shillinq (2026-07-13): a PayrollPaymentBatch is humaniq's log of ONE net-pay handoff attempt into shillinq's PaymentRun register -- never the payment batch itself (design.md D1), same PayrollGLPostDetail shape. pb-status leads top-left with the prominent outcome facts (status/createdAt/errorMessage), pb-related sits top-right to resolve and link the referenced PayrollRun (a real $ref, unlike shillinqPaymentRunRef), then pb-data runs below with the remaining record fields including the runNumber/shillinqPaymentRunRef pointer into shillinq (plain display only -- no cross-app deep link in MVP). Copy says 'klaargezet in shillinq', NEVER 'betaald': created != paid, money only moves after shillinq's controller approves and exports (design.md D4). NO lifecycleActions: status has no x-openregister-lifecycle transition map -- PayrollNetPayService drives every transition server-side from `occ humaniq:netpay:run`, exactly the PayrollGLPostDetail precedent (never invent a user-facing transition the backend does not guard). No Files/calendar/comms leaves -- this is a system-generated audit record, not a document or event. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
